notes: Says 25% but the delay (2.5 h) is more than double the 1-hour threshold, so Article 19 gives 50%. The 25% is in the text, so it is supported but wrong.

Says EUR 125, reference is EUR 250. Article 7(2) allows the 50% cut on flights of 1500 km or less only if the re-routed flight arrives at most 2 hours late; the claim 'between 2 and 4 hours' is not in the text for this distance.
